text:
devon-sales: Quick sync — OpaqueShore signed the LOI, pilot starts next week. Need a short tech handoff: SSO, tenant provisioning, network egress, and a pricing sketch for dedicated capacity. @arjun-arch can you take lead on the architecture handoff? @maria-ps can you prep enablement materials?

arjun-arch: Yep. Will do a 30m walkthrough Wed 10am PT. Main blockers so far: their infra wants a static egress IP range + SCIM-based provisioning. Also they want optional model pinning for compliance.

maria-ps: I can do enablement + quick runbook. Can you drop the egress ranges and what IAM roles we need from them? I’ll make slides and a checklist. :+1:

sam-eng: For tenant provisioning we need these steps from their infra team: 1) VPC peering (if private) or 2) whitelist three egress ranges if public. Example curl to validate callback after SSO:

```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/tenants/validate-callback
```

lex-support: FYI ops already provisioned a staging tenant for the pilot: tenant-id: opaqueshore-stg-03. I’ll start the entitlement flow once we get SSO metadata.

arjun-arch: Egress CIDR we can propose: 10.11.32.0/24 (private peering), else public NAT block: 52.150.192.0/22. They should also send SCIM base url + cert for provisioning. For model pinning, we support model_version in the deployment config, e.g. `model: llm-x86@v1.2.0` — will add to the walkthrough.

devon-sales: Pricing question from their procurement: can we do a 3-month committed pilot with metered overage + a trial discount? They asked for a ballpark monthly commit for "100k tokens/day average, spikes to 1M tokens/day".

maria-ps: For a short pilot we usually recommend Dedicated small (reserved) with burst on Hosted. Ballpark: $14k/mo reserved + metered $0.003/token for burst (very rough). I’ll confirm with finance and get a neat table.

security-bot: SECURITY: Opaqueshore sent back the vendor questionnaire. Key open items: data residency checkbox, KMS integration, and penetration test report. Uploaded at https://redwood.secureshare/surveys/opaqueshore-qa-3098765432.pdf

arjun-arch: I’ll coordinate with Security on KMS/HSM mapping and send template answers. Maria — can you include a 1-slide digest of security posture for their legal team?

maria-ps: Yep — will do: SAML SSO support, SCIM provisioning, KMS integrations (AWS KMS, Azure KeyVault), SOC2 link, and a short table for expected logs/audit hooks.

lex-support: Ops note: to enable burst we need the billing token from procurement and an entitlement flag set on the tenant. Devon, can you confirm procurement timeline?

devon-sales: Procurement says they can approve billing token by Fri EOD if we get the pilot T&Cs tonight. I’ll ping legal.

sam-eng: For the Wed walkthrough I’ll prepare a short demo: provisioning -> SSO test -> model pin -> sample requests and latency metrics. Anyone want to co-present?

arjun-arch: I’ll co-present the architecture and security bits. Maria can do the enablement checklist.

devon-sales: Awesome — plan: 1) I’ll get T&Cs to legal tonight. 2) Arjun/Maria/Sam do Wed 10am PT walkthrough. 3) Lex will finalize tenant entitlement once billing token is in. 4) Security will answer questionnaire in 48h. Thanks all :rocket: 

lex-support: noted, will stand by. :white_check_mark:
